lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged posterior to the branchial region. The centroids form a staggered grid pattern extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating anchor nodes in a rectangular grid-like configuration across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and mid-section of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 6-8 commensal organisms (Echeneidae) is visible in the ventral water column, aligned with the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
